title.suggested: Davis Challenges Bill Ryall; Earlier Ryall-Allen Match Recalled

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Bill Davis challenged retired St. Louis pugilist Bill Ryall, who would fight only for $2,000 a side, and recalled that a Ryall match with Tom Allen, now of Cleveland, had fallen through.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat. Wednesday Morning, Dec. 2, 1868'; before the 1875 merger, so not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: A proposed match between Allen and Bill Ryall, made around the time Ryall came to St. Louis about two years earlier, fell through over a dispute in the choice of a battle ground

notes: Allen is only mentioned in passing; the article is about Davis challenging Ryall. The date of the failed Allen-Ryall match is inferred from 'near two years ago'. Of interest: in 1868 Ryall's saloon was at No. 417 Washington Avenue, between Fourth and Fifth, the address later linked with Allen (facts 009, 017).
